messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected in us-west1 gateway pool. Auto-paging oncall. Metric burst at 2026-03-15T08:11:23Z — 5xx rate 18% over baseline, p95 latency 2.3s. Possible proxy/egress saturation.

oncall-sre: ack — I'm on it. grabbing dashboards and logs.

mike_h: any customer-facing errors yet? which routes?

anya_r: quick snapshot: majority of 5xx tied to ingress proxy -> ml-worker egress (us-west1). A subset of requests hit gateway queue and timeout. Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/completions.

jordan_pl: running a few smoke curls from us-west1 edge:
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'
```
returns: 502, 504 intermittently. Stack traces in proxy show upstream error 503: connection reset by peer.

netops: saw a config push to edge-proxy cluster at 08:09 UTC that increased max-fds and lowered keepalive timeout. rolling back to pre-08:09 is a fast mitigation candidate.

oncall-sre: can you paste the deploy id?

netops: deploy_id: deploy/edge-proxy/20260315-0810 (sha: d9c3f7). Marked as partial rollback candidate.

kevin_p: also seeing ML workers in us-west1 report elevated GC stutters and ephemeral OOMs -> respawning, which increases backend connection churn. logs: `worker-12 ERROR: connection closed by peer` repeated.

mike_h: so two things: proxy config change + worker instability. What's fastest customer-impact mitigation? cross-region steer + limited circuit-breaker on us-west1?

anya_r: agree. plan: 1) throttle/route ~60% traffic off us-west1 to us-east1 and us-central 2) rollback proxy deploy 3) scale up worker pool in us-west1 (temporary) 4) status page update.

oncall-sre: executing traffic steering now. Using routing API to adjust region weights.

oncall-sre: `rb route adjust-weights --service gateway --weights us-west1=0.35,us-east1=0.40,us-central=0.25 --reason "auto-mitigate 5xx surge"`

oncall-sre: applied. watching metrics.

jordan_pl: post-steer quick test:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{remote_addr}\n" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate; done
```
responses: majority 200 from us-east1 backends, a few 502 from us-west1 still. p95 latency down to 0.9s overall.

mike_h: good — reduce customer impact. netops, can you roll back the proxy deploy?

netops: initiating rollback to deploy/edge-proxy/20260315-0758 now. ETA ~2m.

statusbot: Status page draft: "Partial degradation in US West (us-west1) causing increased 5xx for some inference requests. Traffic being redirected; mitigation in progress. No data exfiltration detected." Approve?

kevin_p: yes, publish and add note that teams using pinned model versions might see timeouts.

statusbot: published.

netops: rollback complete. Observability: proxy 5xx rate dropping to ~3% in us-west1. worker churn still present but less severe.

oncall-sre: scaling workers in us-west1 by +30% (temporary). `rb infra scale --pool mlworker-us-west1 +30% --ttl 1h`

anya_r: after scale, worker OOMs reduced. backend connection resets declined. 5xx stabilized ~1.2% and p95 latency 0.8s.

mike_h: good. leave traffic weights as-is for 20 mins, then gradually shift back if healthy. we should also mark this for a follow-up runbook entry: proxy deploy checklist + worker GC tuning.

jordan_pl: captured kernel logs and proxy logs for postmortem. saving to /var/incident/2790012345/artifacts.tar.gz

kevin_p: customers that reported errors: support ticket IDs #23245, #23261. Ops team pinged for follow-ups.

oncall-sre: handing off to daytime SRE: @mike_h you're primary for follow-up and postmortem. I'll stay available for 30m.

mike_h: taking it. can someone summarize the timeline & root-candidates in the channel?

anya_r: tl;dr: recent edge-proxy config push reduced keepalive and bumped fd limits; combined with transient worker GC/OOM churn led to upstream connection resets and queue timeouts. Mitigations: traffic steer, proxy rollback, scale workers.

mike_h: thanks. action items: netops to add pre-deploy smoke for proxy changes (check worker upstream connections), infra to revisit GC tuning for workers under high connection churn, devex to add customer-facing FAQ on region failover.

netops: noted — will create RFC and link here.

statusbot: Status page update: "Mitigation successful; traffic redirected and faulty deploy rolled back. Continued monitoring; partial region degradation resolved in us-west1. Full service healthy."

mike_h: closing active paging. assigning postmortem owner = mike_h. ETA for postmortem doc EOD tomorrow.

incbot: incident resolved (auto). If further regressions occur please re-open or create a new incident thread. :white_check_mark:
